dataset_metadata.description: Loan application outcomes, authorized terms, and underwriting policy evidence.

dataset_level_description.business_purpose: Tracks loan application decision outcomes, approved terms, and the underwriting policies and rules supporting each determination.
dataset_level_description.business_question_supported: What decision was made, what terms were authorized, and which policy or rule supported the outcome?
dataset_level_description.grain: One record per application processing event identified by application_id.
dataset_level_description.storage_and_ingestion: Validated transactional records ingested from underwriting system logs through a micro-batch pipeline.
dataset_level_description.ai_consumption: Supports decision audit, outcome analysis, and model monitoring or recalibration of underwriting thresholds.
dataset_level_description.ai_assumption: Historical fields are treated as immutable representations of the decision context at processing time.

column_level_contract.business_meaning: Unique identifier for one loan application processing event.
Cross-reference key linking the application decision to the applicant profile and related credit records.
Identifies the loan product configuration evaluated for the application.
Point-in-time anchor for the policy version, credit information, and decision outcome.
Current or final underwriting outcome used for approval, operational, and fair-lending analysis.

schema_expectations.nullable_conditional: nullable when decision_status is Denied or Under Review

column_level_contract.business_meaning: Authorized capital amount extended to the consumer, expressed in thousands of USD and bounded by product configuration.

schema_expectations.nullable_conditional: nullable when decision_status is Denied or Under Review

column_level_contract.business_meaning: Authorized repayment term used to assess treatment consistency and product-rule compliance.
Links the decision record to the supporting procedure or document metadata.
Identifies the active underwriting policy document or version used for the decision.

schema_expectations.condition: Required when a policy rule supports the decision; use the applicable rule identifier for Approved, Denied, or Under Review outcomes.

column_level_contract.business_meaning: Documents the underwriting rule that supported or triggered the approval, denial, or review outcome.
Indicates whether the record is active for current operational analysis and AI-ready context.

record_level_rules: approved_amount and approved_term_length must be populated when decision_status is Approved.
approved_amount and approved_term_length should be null when decision_status is Denied or Under Review.
policy_doc_id and rule_id_triggered must identify the policy evidence supporting the decision.
